issuer: the Regional Directorates of Road Transport Services (DRSHTRR) of the General Directorate of Road Transport Services (DPSHTRR)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the site of the General Directorate of Road Transport Services (DPSHTRR). Its page on the licence for categories A1, A2, B1 and B gives the minimum age as 18 and the maximum term of validity as 15 years (confirmed with a medical certificate past 70 under art. 117 of the Road Code); 15 is held, the page's maximum, and the shorter terms the Code may set for some holders aren't. Its page on applying for a licence for the first time says the citizen applies at the Regional Directorate (DRSHTRR) where they passed the practical test, and that issuing the licence takes two payments: the state budget tax, 4,500 lekë for categories B1 and B, and the fee for producing the licence, 4,500 lekë; the two are held together as 9,000 lekë (the 1,000-lekë file-transfer fee, paid only at another directorate than that of residence, and the theory and practical test services, 2,000 and 2,800 lekë, aren't held). The identity card is the ids engine's. The page on converting foreign licences wasn't read; no exchange list is held.

sources.title: DPSHTRR, Pajisja me Leje Drejtimi për Kategorinë A1-A2-B1-B
sources.said: Kushtet për pajisjen me leje drejtimi – Kategoria A1-A2-B1-B ... Mosha minimale : 18 vjeç. ... Afati maksimal i vlefshmërisë : 15 vjet.

sources.title: DPSHTRR, Aplikim për Leje Drejtimi për herë të parë/shtesë kategorie
sources.said: Qytetari paraqitet pranë sporteleve të Drejtorisë Rajonale të Shërbimeve të Transportit Rrugor (DRSHTRR), ku është shpallur fitues në provën praktike, dhe aplikon për pajisjen me leje drejtimi. ... Për pajisjen me leje drejtimi kryhen pagesat: ... 4,500 lekë – për kategoritë B1 dhe B; ... Tarifa për prodhimin e lejes së drejtimit: 4,500 lekë.
